State the egress allowance and the overage price, or write `not published` with the URL read. List the access interfaces: REST API, CLI, SSH, SDK or console only.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- compute/clickhouse-cloud $.egress.terms: The page's 732 hours is a full 24x7 month of 30.5 days ('a full 24×7 month = 732 hours'), not the 30-day trial: 30 days continuously is 720 compute-unit-hours for one compute unit. The page does not say that the 30-day clock ends before the USD 300 for an idle service (that is the lane's inference).
- compute/freeshell-de $.interface: SSH and WebDAV are stated, but SFTP is not named on the services page or on a fresh read of the home page (sha256:e412f5e6ed9de66f8f58b103e086795f4b400ae8c7a2b4f033a0718f59dce6f6). The sftp term is an inference from SSH, not a published fact.
- compute/influxdb-cloud-serverless $.egress.terms: The USD 0.09 per GB data-out rate of the usage-based plan is right, but the free-plan clause is wrong: the Cloud Serverless limits page (fresh read 2026-11-04, https://docs.influxdata.com/influxdb3/cloud-serverless/admin/billing/limits/) publishes a Free Plan read cap of 300 MB of HTTP response payl

- compute/aiven $.egress.terms: the cited page is the Aiven CLI page; it says nothing about network traffic or egress. The value itself is stated by the service-pricing capture sha256:08112895e7d9eedbc1d2c27719997e52d2f4c557f76818f9fcef79d6fcf9bbe9 (see c01), so the confirm cites the wrong source
- compute/clickhouse-cloud $.interface_detail: the first half (the REST API manages organizations and services) is stated; the second half is not: the page names the console only as a support URL, and the other documented route on this page is the official Terraform provider, not the console
- compute/coalbyte-free $.interface: FTP and SFTP are stated, plus a web panel; no API (REST or other) is named on the page. A fresh read of https://coalbyte.com/en (sha256:39c17d41b25a5aa82e07cfca98cc621226e1c226ba8392ea9ee6e5025c5f769c) names no API either, so the value 'rest' is not supported
- compute/coalbyte-free $.interface: same as c07: ftp and sftp are stated, 'rest' is named nowhere on the German or English home page (fresh read sha256:39c17d41b25a5aa82e07cfca98cc621226e1c226ba8392ea9ee6e5025c5f769c)
